description: This file defines the ICatalogViewModelService interface within the Microsoft.eShopWeb.Web.Services namespace. It declares methods for retrieving catalog items, brands, and types for an e-commerce web application.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a page of catalog items filtered by optional brand and type IDs.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of brands as select list items.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of types as select list items.
